highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156 brings Skia m156, a GTK4 GPU canvas and restored Linux NoDependencies font discovery.
highlights_body: The line also updates Uno integration, paces Android continuous rendering to display refresh and corrects stream, font and callback lifetimes. Review the GTK4 coordinate changes, Uno migration and higher Apple and Tizen requirements before upgrading. Collected engine fixes extend beyond Release Candidate 1.

breaking.title: Choose GTK4 painting coordinates explicitly
breaking.body: SKDrawingArea now paints in physical pixels by default on high-density displays. Set IgnorePixelScaling=true to retain logical painting coordinates while keeping full-resolution backing storage. GTK input coordinates remain logical; RawInfo continues to describe physical pixels.

breaking.title: Migrate Uno applications to Uno 7
breaking.body: The non-Windows Uno views now require Uno Platform 7 and .NET 10. Legacy native-renderer packages and pre-Uno 7 WasmShell pipelines are no longer supported. Migrate to Uno 7's unified renderer and .NET SDK WebAssembly build path; Uno.Sdk supplies platform native assets.

breaking.title: Use SKCanvasElement for Uno GPU rendering
breaking.body: On non-Windows Uno targets, SKSwapChainPanel now derives from Grid and uses a raster fallback: GRContext is null and its backend target has framebuffer zero. RaiseOnUnsupported is removed. Remove uses of that property and choose SKCanvasElement when GPU rendering is required. The Windows App SDK facade remains ANGLE-backed.

breaking.title: Raise Apple deployment targets
breaking.body: Both native libraries now require macOS 12 or iOS, tvOS and Mac Catalyst 15. Raise application deployment targets accordingly, preserving any higher managed or framework requirements. These final floors supersede the earlier macOS 11 and iOS/tvOS/Catalyst 14 native baseline in this line.

breaking.title: Move Tizen applications to Tizen 10
breaking.body: The Tizen native packages now target net10.0-tizen10.0 and no longer support Tizen 8 or 9. Upgrade application targets and deployment requirements to Tizen 10. Custom native builds require GCC 14.2 and target x64 or arm64; the former Clang and 32-bit build paths are not fallbacks.

breaking.title: Replace custom fork-specific WinRT builds
breaking.body: The native fork-specific WinRT target is retired. Custom builds relying on that target must move to a supported Windows target. Desktop Windows, WinUI/Windows App SDK and NanoServer remain supported.

breaking.title: Pass complete encoded font buffers
breaking.body: Encoded font operations now throw ArgumentOutOfRangeException for negative byte lengths and ArgumentException for odd GlyphId byte counts. Supply nonnegative lengths and complete 16-bit glyph IDs. Encoded BreakText results count bytes; string and char-span results still count UTF-16 code units.

breaking.title: Keep SKData copy lengths within the source array
breaking.body: SKData.CreateCopy(byte[], ulong) now throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException when the requested length exceeds the array. Pass a length within the source array instead of relying on an out-of-bounds native read.

breaking.title: Use one encoded unit in StringUtilities character conversion
breaking.body: GetUnicodeCharacterCode now requires exactly one encoded unit: ASCII for Utf8, one UTF-16 unit for Utf16, or one UTF-32 unit for Utf32. Use Utf32 for supplementary characters; multi-unit input is rejected. GetString(byte[], SKTextEncoding) now throws ArgumentNullException rather than NullReferenceException for null arrays; update exception handling if needed.

bullets.lead: Skia m156 and upstream correctness fixes
bullets.detail: Updates the renderer to m156 and corrects SkSL validation, GLES BGRA uploads, conic-region storage and partial shader pipelines. Later collected fixes cover clipped convex-path rasterization, glyph replay, reflected hairline caps, text-atlas selection and Graphite readback.

SKGLArea adds GL-backed PaintSurface drawing, a view-owned GRContext, CanvasSize and an optional render loop. Use GTK's QueueRender to invalidate; manually bundled GTK runtimes must include libepoxy for GL dispatch.

Linux NoDependencies assets discover installed fonts under /usr/share/fonts without fontconfig again. Linux HarfBuzzSharp also binds bundled function calls locally, preventing system HarfBuzz loaded by GTK from intercepting calls and mixing incompatible native objects.

Automatic GLTextureView frames, including MAUI SKGLView.HasRenderLoop, follow Choreographer display callbacks instead of swap throughput. Explicit render requests remain independent, rendering stays on the GL worker and missed display pulses coalesce rather than queue.

Native callbacks now use one-byte Skia booleans and four-byte HarfBuzz hb_bool_t values while public managed delegates retain bool. This corrects callback ABI handling, including Apple ARM64 interpreter returns and false-returning HarfBuzz callbacks.

WebGPU C++ support is compiled into libSkiaSharp.a instead of applying C++ flags to application C sources. Archives now consistently use Emscripten 3.1.34 for .NET 8, 3.1.56 for .NET 9/10 and 6.0.2 for .NET 11+. Newer WebGPU consumers need rebuilt, GPU-enabled archives; the .NET 8 built-in WebGPU link path is retained.

bullets.lead: Fewer allocations for managed pixel copies
bullets.detail: Valid managed pixel buffers can be copied directly without an intermediate SKData allocation. Invalid inputs retain the original native-validation path.

bullets.lead: Release borrowed stream references on disposal
bullets.detail: Disposing SKFrontBufferedManagedStream clears its reference to the wrapped stream even when disposeUnderlyingStream is false. It does not dispose the borrowed stream; the caller still owns that responsibility.

bullets.lead: Bound Windows font and view lifetimes
bullets.detail: DWriteCore custom-font data is released after the last dependent typeface clone is disposed instead of remaining rooted by the shared factory. Windows GL view teardown unbinds its own current EGL context before destroying the surface so the native window can be released.
Cached Windows OpenGL entry points retain their backing module. Native integration also corrects optional stream callbacks and XPS COM ownership without changing public signatures.
Library builds align with Windows App SDK 1.7.250909003, and WinUI's bundled ANGLE moves to chromium/8118. These dependency updates do not raise the declared Windows runtime minimum.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Restored Linux NoDependencies font discovery, moved WebGPU support into the WASM archive and updated the Uno views for Uno 7.
contributor_summaries.akoeplinger: Corrected issue-author mentions and disabled dependency automation on the Azure DevOps mirror.
contributor_summaries.VirgilMing: Fixed Linux HarfBuzz symbol preemption and made Blazor CPU sample captures wait for the first paint.
contributor_summaries.dalexsoto: Reviewed contextual code-scanning findings and clarified workflow and sample wording.
contributor_summaries.rolfbjarne: Removed unused sample files that triggered unnecessary scanning findings.

preview_summaries.v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10: Introduced Skia m156, GTK4 GPU rendering and restored Linux NoDependencies font discovery. GTK4 switched to physical-pixel painting by default, WebAssembly archives aligned with .NET 11 and Tizen packages moved to Tizen 10.
preview_summaries.v4.156.0-rc.1.26553.11: Added Uno 7 integration, display-paced Android rendering, stream and font lifetime fixes, corrected callback handling and Linux HarfBuzz symbol binding. Apple deployment floors rose to macOS 12 and iOS, tvOS and Mac Catalyst 15; input validation and upstream rendering corrections also landed.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.100 retains native HarfBuzz 14.4.0 while reducing AddUtf32(string) and feature-string allocations and correcting hb_bool_t callback widths. Its Apple and Tizen requirements and .NET 11 WebAssembly archive selection follow the platform updates above.

v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10.headline: Preview 1 introduces Skia m156, GTK4 GPU rendering and restored Linux NoDependencies font discovery.
v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10.body: GTK4 painting now defaults to physical pixels; enable IgnorePixelScaling for logical coordinates. WebAssembly assets align with .NET 11, and Tizen packages require Tizen 10.

v4.156.0-rc.1.26553.11.headline: The release candidate adds Uno 7 support and corrects font, stream and callback lifetimes.
v4.156.0-rc.1.26553.11.body: It also paces Android rendering to display refresh, tightens input validation and corrects Linux HarfBuzz symbol preemption. Apple libraries now require macOS 12 or iOS, tvOS and Mac Catalyst 15.
